8670.description:
Stone walls close in, cool to the touch. The air is still and smells
faintly of old smoke. A way leads north.

8694.name: The Hiding Place

8694.description:
Fallen needles and leaves muffle every step. Ferns and moss soften the
ground beneath a dim green canopy. A way leads north.

8742.description:
Lantern hooks and faded signboards hang over the street. The paving is
uneven here, patched with newer stone. A way leads up.

up.description: To the up lies The Trail.

8746.description:
Birdsong drifts down through the branches overhead. Old trees crowd
close, their roots knotted across the path. A way leads up.
